verdict.rationale: Fin's pricing page lists analytics-style features ("AI Topics, Trends, AI Recommendations, CX Score, Custom AI Scorecards, Incident Detection") implying it surfaces AI-generated insights from support data, but there is no dedicated documentation, screenshots, or independent corroboration describing how these insights are generated or used. Missing for 10: detailed docs/help articles on the insights/recommendations features, hands-on or community validation that these insights are useful/accurate, and examples of suggestions being acted upon.
